SHARED-F-2-S17.title: Consent Core Logic Enforcement Service Layer
SHARED-F-2-S17.description: Implement core consent decision logic in ConsentService to enforce two-tier rules (e.g., de-identification for Tier 1, identifiable storage for Tier 2). Ensure all downstream services call centralized logic rather than duplicating rules.

SHARED-F-2-S18.title: Consent Integration with Lead Capture and Unknown Question Flows
SHARED-F-2-S18.description: Integrate consent enforcement into lead_capture and unknown_question services to ensure all stored data respects consent tier, including de-identification before persistence and Tier 2 gating for identifiable data.

SHARED-F-2-S19.title: Consent Framework Unit and Integration Tests
SHARED-F-2-S19.description: Develop unit and integration tests validating consent tier transitions, enforcement behavior, API responses, and cross-service compliance (lead capture, unknown questions, tool routing). Include negative tests for improper data handling.
